name: BFS rent by rooms, largest cities (T 09.03.03.42)

measures.definition: Average monthly net rent (without service and heating charges) of every rented or cooperative 2-room flat (one bedroom; Swiss rooms leave out the kitchen), three pooled years of the structural survey.
Average monthly net rent (without service and heating charges) of every rented or cooperative 4-room flat (three bedrooms), three pooled years of the structural survey.

rights.attribution: Source: Federal Statistical Office (BFS), structural survey (SE) and buildings and dwellings statistics (GWS), table T 09.03.03.42

vetted.notes: Official; opendata.swiss marks it 'Open use. Must provide the source', commercial use allowed.

caveats: Every tenancy, sitting tenants included: flats newly offered in Zurich and Geneva cost more.
